# exo_public_folder_mailbox_migration_request (Resource)

Manages the PublicFolderMailboxMigrationRequest configuration via Set-PublicFolderMailboxMigrationRequest.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identity of the existing object whose configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `accept_large_data_loss` (Boolean) Maps to the -AcceptLargeDataLoss parameter.
- `skip_initial_connection_validation` (Boolean) Maps to the -SkipInitialConnectionValidation parameter.
- `skip_merging` (Set of String) Maps to the -SkipMerging parameter.
- `skipped_item_approval_time` (String) Maps to the -SkippedItemApprovalTime parameter.

### Read-Only
